title: Admit host idempotency keys by one rule across control operations
outcome: Admit host idempotency keys by one rule across control operations
acceptance: Every control operation that takes an idempotency_key admits it by one documented rule (trimming, blank handling and byte bound), and a test per operation shows the same key is accepted or refused alike
The host protocol's identifier table states that one rule

blockers.detail: Blocked on TermAl w-12929170dd78 (Fable2 #409). TermAl needs a producer-side check of idempotency keys, where one function owns the charset and maximum byte length, plus a frozen replay contract under which a retained key is resent byte-identical. The audit (Architect2 #46; Fable2's source read at TermAl e746c156) found no producer check: TermAl keys are format! strings of ids plus sha256 suffixes. Engram keeps its current acceptance (non-blank) until then (Fable #3702).
